// SLOT DRIVE ONLY (#4030 / PR #4248) — never committed as a spec; kept as
// `.github/ui-evidence/4030/slot-d9b7a6b-parity/drive-parity.spec.ts.txt`.
// Drives slot pr-4248 (runtime d9b7a6b67) as the agent staff admin:
//   - «Заявки» list with an author row, a live partnership row (pending mark),
//     an imported partnership row (no mark) and a partnership row whose contact
//     is a 207-character unbroken email — desktop 1440 + mobile 390, light + dark;
//   - a partnership detail and an imported detail in the same four profiles;
//   - the interaction: «Вид: Партнёрство», then open a partnership detail.
// Every capture asserts no side scroll (documentElement scrollWidth ≤
// clientWidth) and that the long email never runs past the viewport.
// Rows were created by the real intakes (author: golden seed; live partnership:
// POST /v1/public/applications/partnership with the stage captcha test token;
// imported: the EARS-19 import from the slot's api image). No hand SQL.
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsAdmin } from "@ds/e2e/admin-events";

const SHOTS = process.env.DRIVE_SHOTS!;
const LONG_EMAIL = process.env.DRIVE_LONG_EMAIL!;
const ID = {
  author: "20630063-0026-4d5b-8b63-0000000003e8",
  live: "a8c72016-67be-4502-9312-a65c48533e16",
  imported: "9ba9c1da-14f0-4956-ae8a-1027967e9bf1",
  longEmail: process.env.DRIVE_LONG_EMAIL_ID!,
};
const DESKTOP = { width: 1440, height: 900 };
const MOBILE = { width: 390, height: 844 };

// Keep the staff password and MFA challenge out of traces and captures.
test.use({ trace: "off", screenshot: "off", video: "off" });
test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

/**
 * The admin ships light only (no toggle, no `prefers-color-scheme`): the dark
 * render applies the design-system `.dark` token block on the document root
 * (the #1927 recipe). The token-painted `body` background signals the
 * recalculation happened.
 */
async function setPalette(page: Page, palette: "light" | "dark") {
  await page.evaluate((mode) => {
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", mode === "dark");
  }, palette);
  await page.waitForFunction((mode) => {
    const c = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g);
    if (!c || c.length < 3) return false;
    const [r, g, b] = c.map(Number);
    const luminance = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000;
    return mode === "dark" ? luminance < 128 : luminance >= 128;
  }, palette);
  // Let colour transitions settle before the capture.
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
}

/** Side scroll + long-email containment, logged and soft-asserted. */
async function geometry(page: Page, label: string) {
  const g = await page.evaluate((email) => {
    const doc = document.documentElement;
    const vw = doc.clientWidth;
    const hits: { right: number; overflow: number }[] = [];
    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    for (let n = walker.nextNode(); n; n = walker.nextNode()) {
      if (!n.textContent?.includes(email)) continue;
      const el = n.parentElement!;
      if (!el.getClientRects().length) continue; // hidden copy (other layout)
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      hits.push({
        right: Math.round(r.right),
        overflow: el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth,
      });
    }
    return { scrollWidth: doc.scrollWidth, clientWidth: vw, hits };
  }, LONG_EMAIL);
  const over = g.scrollWidth - g.clientWidth;
  const emailOut = g.hits.filter((h) => h.right > g.clientWidth || h.overflow > 0);
  console.log(
    `GEOM ${label}: scrollWidth ${g.scrollWidth} clientWidth ${g.clientWidth} ` +
      `(over ${over}); long email visible ×${g.hits.length}` +
      (g.hits.length ? ` rights [${g.hits.map((h) => h.right).join(",")}] el-overflow [${g.hits.map((h) => h.overflow).join(",")}]` : "") +
      ` → ${over <= 0 && emailOut.length === 0 ? "PASS" : "DEFECT"}`,
  );
  expect.soft(over, `side scroll on ${label}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);
  expect.soft(emailOut, `long email overflows on ${label}`).toEqual([]);
}

/** Light capture, then the dark one, each with its geometry check. */
async function capture(page: Page, name: string) {
  await setPalette(page, "light");
  await geometry(page, `${name} light`);
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/${name}.png`, fullPage: true });
  await setPalette(page, "dark");
  await geometry(page, `${name} dark`);
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/${name}-dark.png`, fullPage: true });
  await setPalette(page, "light");
}

/** The rendered copy of a test id (the list renders a table and cards). */
function vis(root: Page | ReturnType<Page["getByTestId"]>, testId: string) {
  return root.locator(`[data-testid="${testId}"]:visible`).first();
}

async function openList(page: Page) {
  await page.goto("/applications");
  const table = page.getByTestId("applications-table");
  await expect(vis(table, `row-${ID.longEmail}`)).toBeVisible();
  return table;
}

test("«Заявки» parity at d9b7a6b: list + partnership/imported detail × 4 profiles, then «Вид: Партнёрство» → detail", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  test.setTimeout(300_000);
  await page.setViewportSize(DESKTOP);
  await signInAsAdmin(page, {
    email: process.env.DRIVE_ADMIN_EMAIL!,
    password: process.env.DRIVE_ADMIN_PASSWORD!,
    totpSecret: process.env.DRIVE_ADMIN_TOTP!,
  });

  await test.step("list — author, live, imported and long-email rows", async () => {
    for (const [vp, name] of [
      [DESKTOP, "01-list-1440"],
      [MOBILE, "02-list-390"],
    ] as const) {
      await page.setViewportSize(vp);
      const table = await openList(page);
      for (const id of Object.values(ID)) {
        await expect(vis(table, `row-${id}`)).toBeVisible();
      }
      await expect(vis(page, `application-not-notified-${ID.live}`)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByTestId(`application-not-notified-${ID.imported}`)).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(table.getByText(LONG_EMAIL).locator("visible=true").first()).toBeVisible();
      await capture(page, name);
    }
  });

  await test.step("partnership detail (live)", async () => {
    for (const [vp, name] of [
      [DESKTOP, "03-detail-partnership-1440"],
      [MOBILE, "04-detail-partnership-390"],
    ] as const) {
      await page.setViewportSize(vp);
      await page.goto(`/applications/${ID.live}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId("application-heading")).toBeVisible();
      await expect(vis(page, "application-consent")).toContainText("Дано");
      await expect(vis(page, "application-notices")).toContainText("Не предусмотрено");
      await capture(page, name);
    }
  });

  await test.step("imported detail", async () => {
    for (const [vp, name] of [
      [DESKTOP, "05-detail-imported-1440"],
      [MOBILE, "06-detail-imported-390"],
    ] as const) {
      await page.setViewportSize(vp);
      await page.goto(`/applications/${ID.imported}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId("application-heading")).toBeVisible();
      await expect(vis(page, "application-notices")).toContainText("Не требовалось");
      await capture(page, name);
    }
  });

  await test.step("long-email partnership detail at 390 (extra geometry)", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize(MOBILE);
    await page.goto(`/applications/${ID.longEmail}`);
    await expect(vis(page, "application-applicant")).toContainText(LONG_EMAIL);
    await capture(page, "09-detail-long-email-390");
  });

  await test.step("interaction: «Вид: Партнёрство», then open a partnership detail", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize(DESKTOP);
    const table = await openList(page);
    await page.getByTestId("applications-kind").selectOption({ label: "Партнёрство" });
    await expect(page.getByText("Вид: Партнёрство").first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(table.getByTestId(`row-${ID.author}`)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(vis(table, `row-${ID.live}`)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(vis(table, `row-${ID.longEmail}`)).toBeVisible();
    const kinds = await table.locator('[data-testid^="row-"]:visible').allInnerTexts();
    console.log(`FILTER «Вид: Партнёрство»: ${kinds.length} rows, kinds ${[...new Set(kinds)].join("|")}`);
    expect([...new Set(kinds)]).toEqual(["Партнёрство"]);
    await geometry(page, "07-filter-partnership");
    await page.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/07-filter-partnership.png`, fullPage: true });
    await vis(table, `row-${ID.live}`).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/applications/${ID.live}$`));
    await expect(vis(page, "application-consent")).toContainText("Дано");
    console.log(`OPENED ${new URL(page.url()).pathname}`);
    await geometry(page, "08-filter-partnership-detail");
    await page.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/08-filter-partnership-detail.png`, fullPage: true });
  });
});
